title: CatalogToolDescriptor
description: One tool of a catalog item (02-lld §5.4). `digest` is the canonical digest of {name, description, inputSchema, effect, sink} and, when declared, the behaviour hints in `annotations` (not `provider`); a missing effect is an unclassified tool (a write that may leave the deployment).

inputSchema.description: The JSON Schema the model is given for the tool's arguments.

sink.description: Where a write's arguments go (the `sink` tool tag); null is external.

annotations.description: The behaviour hints an MCP tool declares (MCP tool annotations). They decide its effect and sink, so `digest` covers the ones declared, as the admin's approval of the tool does; absent on a tool that declares none.

provider.description: Who provides the tool, as its toolset's registration declares it: `platform` (the deployment's own, allowed by a run's other fields) or `connector` (a configured integration's, granted by its pinned instance). Not covered by `digest`; absent on a tool no toolset registers (an MCP server's).
